Class PendingSignUpFilter

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.web.filter.GenericFilterBean
org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter
org.jwcarman.who.oidc.PendingSignUpFilter
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.servlet.Filter, org.springframework.beans.factory.Aware, org.springframework.beans.factory.BeanNameAware, org.springframework.beans.factory.DisposableBean, org.springframework.beans.factory.InitializingBean, org.springframework.context.EnvironmentAware, org.springframework.core.env.EnvironmentCapable, org.springframework.web.context.ServletContextAware
public final class PendingSignUpFilter extends org.springframework.web.filter.OncePerRequestFilter
The pending sign-up endpoints: GET /who/oidc/pending describes it for the confirm page, POST /who/oidc/pending/sign-up confirms a sign-up (signed out), and POST /who/oidc/pending/link links it to the identity that started it, within the recent sign-in window. Each POST uses the pending sign-up up. A filter, not a controller, so a sign-up runs the chain's session strategy. The paths shown are under the default root; each follows who.base-path.

    • PendingSignUpFilter

      public PendingSignUpFilter(WhoPaths paths, OidcSignUpService signUpService, IdentityRepository identities, WhoSessionSecurityContextRepository sessions, org.springframework.security.web.authentication.session.SessionAuthenticationStrategy sessionStrategy, PendingSignUps pendingSignUps, WhoExceptionHandoff handoff, WhoEventPublisher eventPublisher, LastSignInCookie lastSignInCookie, Clock clock, Duration linkWindow)
      Creates the filter.
      Parameters:
      paths - where the endpoints live
      signUpService - confirms sign-ups and links
      identities - finds the identity signed in
      sessions - stores the who session
      sessionStrategy - the chain's session fixation protection and CSRF rotation
      pendingSignUps - keeps pending sign-ups in the session
      handoff - answers errors through the application's exception handling
      eventPublisher - where sign-in events are published
      lastSignInCookie - remembers the provider used, or null when turned off
      clock - the current time
      linkWindow - how recently the identity must have signed in to link an account
